---
title: "Photos can be used with permission and credit :)"
format:
  html:
    lightbox:
      match: auto
      loop: true
      desc-position: bottom
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| output: asis

# ---- Settings ---------------------------------------------------------
root          <- "img/gallery"   # folder that holds your photos
show_captions <- FALSE            # captions are made from the file names
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# "01-heron-island_reef.jpg" -> "Heron island reef"
pretty <- function(f) {
  x <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  x <- sub("^[0-9]+[-_ ]*", "", x)
  x <- gsub("[-_]+", " ", x)
  paste0(toupper(substring(x, 1, 1)), substring(x, 2))
}

# All images directly inside a folder, sorted by file name
list_images <- function(dir) {
  sort(list.files(dir,
                  pattern = "\\.(jpe?g|png|webp|gif)$",
                  ignore.case = TRUE,
                  full.names = TRUE))
}

# Write one gallery block
write_gallery <- function(files, group) {
  cat("::: {.gallery}\n\n")
  for (f in files) {
    cap <- if (show_captions) pretty(f) else ""
    cat(sprintf('![%s](%s){group="%s" fig-alt="%s"}\n\n',
                cap, utils::URLencode(f), group, pretty(f)))
  }
  cat(":::\n\n")
}

# 1. Photos placed directly in img/gallery/ come first, with no heading
top <- list_images(root)
if (length(top) > 0) write_gallery(top, "all")

# 2. Each subfolder becomes its own section, named after the folder
for (d in sort(list.dirs(root, recursive = FALSE))) {
  files <- list_images(d)
  if (length(files) == 0) next
  cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n", pretty(d)))
  write_gallery(files, basename(d))
}
```
